content.text: The elder,
To the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth:
Beloved, I pray that in every way you may prosper and enjoy good health, as your soul also prospers.

content: For I was overjoyed when the brothers came and testified about your devotion to the truth, in which you continue to walk.

So if I come, I will call attention to his malicious slander against us. And unsatisfied with that, he refuses to welcome the brothers and forbids those who want to do so, even putting them out of the church.

content.text: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is of God; the one who does evil has not seen God.
